hooks.name: Figma Library Sync
hooks.description: When a new CSS pattern file is created in src/ui/patterns/, remind the agent to activate the figma-library-sync skill and sync the new component to the Figma library file including variables, component set, code syntax, and code snippets.

action.prompt: A new component CSS pattern was created. When the component is stable and ready for library sync, the user can activate the figma-library-sync skill to push it to the Figma library (variables, component set, code syntax, and code snippets). Mention this to the user but do not start the sync automatically — the CSS may still be in progress.
